content_of_post_to_comment: I get into these slumps that are almost absolutely a result of a deeper depression inside me, but i know i'm not special and that people are definitely going through worse stuff than me, i figure everybody is fighting to keep their heads up, but how do you guys do it so consistently ? i feel like the max that i've consistently grinded, had a set schedule, did what i needed to do, was 2 months. it feels like im on and on/off 2 week cycle of being a productive adult and being a bump on a pickle. im in that slump right now. i do not want to do anything but sleep right now and i just woke up.. its 9 35 this is embarrassing stuff lmao. Before any advice is offered like, you need to push through even when you don't want to do it, or anything of that nature, that advice also applies when im not in a slump like this, work is always tedious and hard, there just seems to be a strong shift in like gumption?, get up and go lol ? idk how to word it. it just feels different than a complete motivation problem, ive worked hard before in my life lol so i know how beneficial to me it is, and i want nothing more than to reap those benefits. hopefully that made sense, i honestly am more curious to know if anyone else is experiencing something similar right now, but i would love any advice pretty please and thank you :)
